elections.words: Result to pay: at once or in two instalments
elections.state_words: The amount this return settles does not go the way its result does, as when the whole amount to pay is suspended against your spouse's refund. Cadrumo does not yet compute the remainder for this year's form, so it cannot be settled here.
elections.help: Paying in two instalments adds no interest or surcharge. The return must be filed within its filing period, and a corrective return cannot be paid this way. The 60% is paid when you file; if it is not paid on time, the whole amount falls due. When the first instalment is direct-debited too, the second is charged to the same account.
